brokenworld.visit.book.title: Diary
brokenworld.visit.book.page1:
Day 1.

The trees are not right. Nobody else sees it.
brokenworld.visit.book.page2: There is somebody at the window at night. It doesn't move when I look.
brokenworld.visit.book.page3: It was standing by my bed. It watched %s sleep.
brokenworld.visit.book.page4:
It knows where you live.

I didn't write this.
commands.brokenworld.finale_stopped: The finale was stopped, everyone is back home
note.brokenworld.1.1: Day 2. The trees changed. I thought I was imagining it.
note.brokenworld.1.2: Bark of the wrong kind. Leaves of the wrong colour.
note.brokenworld.2.1: It stands behind a tree every evening.
note.brokenworld.2.2: When I look straight at it, it is not there.
note.brokenworld.3.1: My house got bigger on the inside.
note.brokenworld.3.2: I walked for an hour and never reached a wall.
note.brokenworld.4.1: I fell through the ground. There is no sky here.
note.brokenworld.4.2: Only corridors. And footsteps behind me.
note.brokenworld.5.1: Throw them into the pit. All five.
note.brokenworld.5.2: Then it lets you go. Probably.
finale.brokenworld.maze: Find 5 notes and throw them into the pit
finale.brokenworld.burned: A note vanished into the pit (%s/%s)
